title: US issues first outbound investment fine over Chinese robotics AI deal
why_it_matters_hint: First enforcement under US curbs on investment in China's tech sector; the fine itself is small.
notes: Pool item is the South China Morning Post (HTTP 403, blocked). The Information is paywalled; only its public summary (meta description) was readable: the US Treasury said on Wednesday it fined Amidi Group, a California real estate company, $200,000 for failing to notify Treasury of a Chinese subsidiary's investment into Noematrix, a Shanghai-based company, in the first penalty under the outbound investment programme for China's tech sector. The 'robotics AI' description comes only from the SCMP and Cryptopolitan headlines. Other copies seen in search: BigGo Finance, Tokenpost, UA.NEWS, Cryptopolitan.
